item.title: Top 5 Steps to Include Project References in a .NET NuGet Package
item.description:
Creating maintainable NuGet packages in .NET becomes challenging when dealing with multiple project references. By default, dotnet pack does not include project-to-project references, leading to a fragmented packaging process. This guide covers the top 5 steps to pack your project references into a single NuGet package using MSBuild and custom configurations.

Top 5 Steps to Include Project References in a .NET NuGet Package

1. Why Project References Aren’t Included in dotnet pack

By design, dotnet pack excludes project references when generating a NuGet package. This prevents large dependency chains from being packed into one NuGet file. However, you can work around this limitation by packaging each project separately or by using a meta-package.

item.title: Top 5 Steps to Resolve 'Possible Null Reference Assignment' Warning in Blazor
item.description:
In Blazor development, you might encounter a warning that says “Possible null reference assignment” when dealing with nullable parameters in components. This can be perplexing, especially when you believe that the parameter and argument are both correctly defined as nullable. This post outlines a series of steps to resolve this issue effectively.

Top 5 Steps to Resolve ‘Possible Null Reference Assignment’ Warning in Blazor

1. Understand the Nullable Reference Types Feature

Before addressing the warning, it’s crucial to understand how nullable reference types work in C#. This feature, introduced in C# 8.0, helps to identify potential null reference issues at compile time. It enables developers to declare whether a reference type can be null.

item.title: Top 5 Steps to Disable Anti-Forgery Cookies in .NET 8 Blazor Apps
item.description:
Disabling anti-forgery cookies in .NET 8 Blazor apps is sometimes necessary for development or specific use cases. This post explores the top five steps to disable these cookies, ensuring that your app works seamlessly without unwanted security features during development.

Top 5 Steps to Disable Anti-Forgery Cookies in .NET 8 Blazor Apps

1. Configure Razor Pages Options

Disabling anti-forgery tokens can be achieved by configuring Razor Pages options.

builder.Services.AddRazorPages().AddRazorPagesOptions(o => 
{
    o.Conventions.ConfigureFilter(new IgnoreAntiforgeryTokenAttribute());
});
